annotations.comment: Labels:io.k8s.description: The Universal Base Image Minimal is a stripped down image that uses microdnf as a package manager. This base image is freely redistributable, but Red Hat only supports Red Hat technologies through subscriptions for Red Hat products. This image is maintained by Red Hat and updated regularly.
Labels:io.k8s.display-name: Red Hat Universal Base Image 9 Minimal
Labels:summary: NoSQL data store using the Seastar framework, compatible with Apache Cassandra And Amazon DynamoDB protocols
